explanation: A king of Israel who ruled for 16 years and fought against the Arameans to restore cities in Israel.
A prophet in Israel, successor to the prophet Elijah, who performed miracles and gave counsel to the kings of Israel.
Father of Joash and king of Israel before him, who did evil in the Lord's sight and suffered under Aramean oppression.
King of Aram, who oppressed Israel and fought against Joash and Jehoahaz.
The Almighty Creator who, according to Genesis, created heaven, earth, and all life.
A weapon used in war, symbolizing here Israel's power and ability to fight enemies.
Part of the bow, representing the individual battles and victories that Israel could achieve with God's help.
Broke God's commands and lived in a way that was not in accordance with His will.
People from Aram, an ancient kingdom in the Middle East that was often in conflict with Israel.
